entities.summary: Juan Antonio Marín Lozano is a Spanish businessman and politician. He first took office in the 2007 local elections in which his local independent group was elected to the city council in his hometown of Sanlúcar de Barrameda in the Province of Cádiz. He served as deputy mayor until 2015, in government with the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE).

entities.name: Juan Marín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Antonio Marín Lozano is a Spanish businessman and politician. He first took office in the 2007 local elections in which his local independent group was elected to the city council in his hometown of Sanlúcar de Barrameda in the Province of Cádiz. He served as deputy mayor until 2015, in government with the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE).
